entries.content: Shuten Doji is the head of the Doji clan and holds the title of The Demon King as the progenitor of the Oni race. He is a merciless and callous man, who has sired dozens if not hundreds of children, caring more about propagating his bloodline than any individual child. Despite this, if he finds one of this children mistreated by humans he will stop at nothing to destroy them.
